semantic_contract.economic_sequence: frozen persistent collapse gap-zone -> independent lower regime -> first return to primary layer -> frozen E1 legal entry -> rejection or oscillation -> legal full repair or non-resolution
frozen_state: Outcome V1 E1 confirmation and next legal minute entry
semantic_contract.entry: first completed minute close >= L after frozen first return, then first subsequent legal minute open; entries above U remain the frozen Outcome V1 non-executable set

clock.t_plus_one: first later market session/session offset 1; no same-day sale
clock.horizon_close: session at entry_cal_idx+H; if its close is not legally executable, first later legal open before 2021-12-31
clock.primary_cohort: require observable entry_cal_idx+60 no later than 2021-12-31; shorter-horizon outputs use this common cohort

execution.target_fill: on D1 or later, first legal minute open at/above coordinate U fills at actual open; otherwise first legal minute whose high reaches U fills at U
execution.same_minute_target_loss_order: unknown; target-before-loss requires target bar time strictly earlier than adverse-threshold bar time
execution.winner_mae: minimum valid coordinate low from entry through the minute strictly before first legal target bar; target bar is excluded because intrabar ordering is unknown
execution.full_or_horizon: target execution if first; otherwise authoritative QD-010 risk exit if required; otherwise H close or first later legal open
execution.corporate_actions: accepted QD-010 known-at pre-effective risk exit and exact cash-only entitlement; unresolved action timing fails closed

verdict_order: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED if any required correctness or lineage invariant fails
ZONE_FILL_HIGH_BUT_T1_CONSTRAINED if structural fill is high but the legal curve and same-day revisit diagnostics show T+1 removes most target capture
ZONE_FILL_HIGH_BUT_RISK_GEOMETRY_POOR if legal fill is substantial but winner MAE, severe loss, target-before-loss, or FULL_OR_H40/H60 payoff is poor
ZONE_RESOLUTION_TOO_SLOW_FOR_CURRENT_STRATEGY_FAMILY if most incremental legal resolution arrives only after 40 sessions with decaying hazard and unattractive underwater/payoff behavior
ZONE_MONETIZATION_STRUCTURE_PRESENT if legal capture, target distance, risk geometry, date-equal payoff, chronology, and concentration are jointly supportive

verdict_quantitative_implementation.high_fill: 60D structural or legal fill >= 60% as applicable
verdict_quantitative_implementation.material_t1_gap: 60D structural minus legal fill >= 15 percentage points
verdict_quantitative_implementation.slow_resolution: legal fill gain from 20D to 60D >= 15 percentage points, 41-60D hazard below 1-5D hazard, and FULL_OR_H60 event mean <= 0 or median <= 0
verdict_quantitative_implementation.supportive_structure: 60D legal fill >= 60%, median net target distance >= 2%, severe_loss10 <= 30%, U-before-loss10 >= 60%, event mean and median FULL_OR_H60 > 0, date-equal mean FULL_OR_H60 > 0, and positive event-mean FULL_OR_H60 in at least 5 of 8 years

forbidden: portfolio CAGR, Sharpe, Calmar, NAV, or walk-forward champion
